title: ModelSettings passes arbitrary keyword arguments to the model provider

requirements.name: 保存与序列化
requirements.description: extra_args is a field of ModelSettings, defaults to None and is serialized by to_json_dict.

requirements.name: 合并时覆盖的一方优先
requirements.description: resolve merges the two dictionaries; a key present on both sides takes the override value.

requirements.name: 一方为空或两方都为空时的合并
requirements.description: resolve keeps one side when the other is None and leaves extra_args None when both are None.

requirements.name: 透传到 Chat Completions
requirements.description: OpenAIChatCompletionsModel forwards extra_args to chat.completions.create together with the regular parameters.

requirements.name: 透传到 LiteLLM
requirements.description: LitellmModel merges extra_args into the keyword arguments of litellm.acompletion.

requirements.name: 参数为空时的行为
requirements.description: None and an empty dictionary add no keyword arguments and leave the regular parameters intact.
